adaptations.purpose: Additive relevance boost when ranking project memory for a context packet.
modifications: 'project scope' boost (0.25) becomes location relevance: the memory links a path/symbol in the current selection
stack keywords derived from the Fehm graph (languages + external packages) instead of detectProjectType/filesystem
base score is query-term relevance instead of instinct confidence; a boost never admits an otherwise unrelated entry
ECC_INSTINCT_RELEVANCE_RANKING env toggle and fs helpers removed

notUsed: ECC hooks, agents, installers, session infrastructure, global memory, plugin system. Snapshot restored from Fehm's own git history (previously vendored at the same commit).
